HiGHS JavaScript / WebAssembly solver
Package: highs 1.15.3
Source: https://github.com/lovasoa/highs-js
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/highs/-/highs-1.15.3.tgz
License: MIT (included as LICENSE)
Files highs.mjs and highs.wasm are the unmodified npm distribution.
Loaded locally in a Web Worker; no third-party API is contacted by the app.
